title: Consumer Credit Default Risk & Portfolio Monitoring
businessProblem: Which approved academic consumer-credit records show elevated retrospective default-risk patterns, and what evidence supports governed portfolio research?
stakeholder: Credit-risk analyst, portfolio executive, review-operations lead, and risk-governance reviewer
decision: Compare portfolio posture, bounded historical review-capacity trade-offs, non-demographic cohort concentration, model-validation evidence, and deterministic record simulation without making a lending decision.

source.dataBoundary: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients, CC BY 4.0. The deployed product publishes non-demographic research fields; demographics remain local and audit-only.

evidence.claim: The deployed non-demographic analyst workspace passes database health, release-lineage, security-header, cache-policy, 30,000-row integrity, and protected-field exclusion checks.
The calibrated challenger achieved AUROC 0.7916, PR-AUC 0.5764, Brier score 0.1314, and 10-bin calibration error 0.0124 on the fixed stratified UCI benchmark split.
